guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails during the step where it runs 'python3.11 -m ensurepip --upgrade && python3.11 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip setuptools wheel'. The error message is: 'ensurepip is disabled in Debian/Ubuntu for the system python. Python modules for the system python are usually handled by dpkg and apt-get.' This occurs because Ubuntu disables ensurepip for the system Python to encourage users to install pip via the package manager. Since the Dockerfile installs python3-pip via apt-get already, running ensurepip to upgrade pip is redundant and fails. To fix this, remove the entire RUN command that calls 'python3.11 -m ensurepip --upgrade && python3.11 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip setuptools wheel' from the Dockerfile. Instead, rely on the installed python3-pip package and upgrade pip and essential Python packages directly with 'python3.11 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip setuptools wheel' after activating the conda environment or within that environment as appropriate. This fix will allow the Docker build to complete successfully.
